verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never describes spike protection, per-key (DSN) rate limits, or mute/ignore rules for issues or alerts. The only nearby items are bare page titles ('Billing Quota Management', 'Advanced quota management', 'Issue Status', 'Alerts') with no content showing they deliver noise suppression. These are adjacent billing and triage features, not documented evidence for this story.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can fight alert fatigue with spike protection, per-key rate limits, and mute/ignore rules so one bad deploy doesn't page the whole team all night
